verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a Learnings knowledge base: review preferences it picks up from chat conversations are stored and applied automatically to future reviews (coderabbit-docs-51, coderabbit-docs-7, coderabbit-docs-1), and it auto-detects convention files like CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as review criteria (coderabbit-docs-10). The FAQ confirms learnings persist as retained data (coderabbit-supp-2), and a community reply echoes, with hedging, that it 'supposedly' remembers feedback (coderabbit-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that learnings measurably change later reviews, and documented learning from past review decisions beyond explicit chat (e.g., accepted or dismissed suggestions).
